column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs (the cluster job runs ./engine/... too) while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name rather than by delta, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset and CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set: go test ./engine/ -run TestForceResolveRunsTheDefersItOwes -count=1 -json reports exactly the mysql and mssql arms skipping. The arms have to exist even where they skip: cleat#1152 adds the MARK branch to adminForceResolve three times, once per dialect, each with its own SQL dialect for the interval arithmetic and its own row-lock spelling (FOR UPDATE on postgres and mysql, UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK on mssql), so a postgres-only run cannot vouch for the other two. Verified failable by replacing the deferPhaseOwed branch with `if false` on all three: the defer-owed arms redden with status "done" where "terminating" was wanted, while the no-defer control still passes.
